socialite.name: Kathleen Agnes Cavendish
notable_relations: Sister of future U.S. President John F. Kennedy
Daughter of Joseph P. Kennedy, Sr.

marriage_details.description: Kathleen Agnes Cavendish (née Kennedy), an American socialite, was the wife of William Cavendish, Marquess of Hartington, who was the elder son of Edward Cavendish, 10th Duke of Devonshire.
